digest.component_or_area: plan review gate / CLI and MCP interface
propositions: The retryable/cause discrimination for passed-but-unsigned attestations exists only in CLI code and is absent from the MCP surface
MCP agents receive verdict: PASS for a plan review whose signature failed to persist, and proceed downstream where the claim gate refuses because the signature was never written
The exit-11 recovery mechanism (sign_review) is already exposed over MCP but agents are not signaled to use it
The CLI and MCP implementations must share a single classifier below both front-ends that produces byte-identical stderr for CLI and structured retryable metadata for MCP
